title: 快递找不到你
setting: Saturday, 10 am, sixth floor, still in pyjamas. A parcel from home is on its way.

silence.en: Hello? Hello? Can you hear me?

hangup.zh: 没人是吧？那我给你退回去了啊。
hangup.en: Nobody there? Then I'm sending it back.
He sent it back. Somewhere, a box of live crabs is riding back to the depot.

say.tip: 喂 = hello, but only on the phone, and usually with a rising tone: wéi? Add 您好 for a stranger, or 哪位 for 'who's calling?'.

silence.en: You picked up. Why aren't you saying anything?

steps.zh: 喂，你好，快递！你这个地址我找不着啊！
steps.en: Hi, courier here! I can't find your address!

say.en: The line keeps cutting out. Tell him you can't hear him well.
answers: 我听不太清楚，您再说一遍？
say.gloss: I can't quite hear you. Could you say that again?
say.tip: 我听不太清楚 = I can't quite hear you; 听不清 is the blunt version. 再说一遍 = say it again.

ok.zh: 我在你们小区门口，转了三圈了！
ok.en: I'm at your front gate. I've been round three times!

fail.zh: 啊？你说啥？我这边车太多了！
fail.en: What? There's too much traffic here!

0.tip: 再说一遍 = say it once more.

steps.zh: 我赶时间啊，后面还有八十个件呢。
steps.en: I'm in a hurry. I've got eighty more parcels after yours.
How about I just send it back?

say.en: He's about to send it back. Tell him to put it in the parcel locker.
say.gloss: No no no, put it in the parcel locker!
say.tip: 快递柜 = parcel locker: you get a pick-up code by text. 别别别 = no no no, three times for urgency.

ok.zh: 快递柜满了！而且你这个……好像在动啊。
ok.en: The lockers are full! And yours... seems to be moving.

0.gloss: Put it in the parcel locker!

steps.zh: 是螃蟹吧？刚爬出来一只！
steps.en: It's crabs, isn't it? One just climbed out!

say.en: The lockers are full. Tell him to just leave it at the gate, then.
say.gloss: Then just leave it at the gate.
say.tip: 放门口就行 = just leave it at the door (or the gate). ……就行 = '…will do': the easy-going 'that's fine'.

alts.en: Ask him to leave it with the guard
alts.gloss: Leave it with the guard, then.

then.zh: 门卫大爷说了，活的不收。
then.en: The guard says he doesn't take anything alive.

fail.en: So where do I put it?

steps.zh: 哎，有只猫一直盯着你这箱螃蟹。
steps.en: Hey, there's a cat that's been eyeing your crabs this whole time.

say.en: A cat is closing in. Tell him you're coming right down.
say.tip: 我马上下来 = I'll be right down. You say 下来, 'come down', because he's the one waiting downstairs.

silence.en: Are you coming down or not?

hangup.zh: 不等了，我还有八十个件呢！
hangup.en: I can't wait. I've got eighty more!
He left the box at the gate. The cat is having a very good Saturday.

ok.zh: 快点啊！我帮你看着！去去去！
ok.en: Hurry! I'll guard it! Shoo! Shoo!

fail.en: What? Are you coming down or not?

steps.en: You fly down six floors in slippers. Final score: you seven crabs, the cat one.
steps.zh: 你穿着拖鞋，从六楼一路冲了下去。
